bio.text: Mark Cohen, a registered nonpartisan from Lemoyne, Nebraska, was certified for the November 3, 2026 ballot in Nebraska's 3rd Congressional District.
He is a former Air Force judge advocate and former special assistant U.S. attorney for Nebraska.
The Nebraska Examiner also described him as a karate instructor.

sources.title: Nonpartisan Mark Cohen certified for Nebraska's 3rd Congressional District ballot
Mark Cohen runs nonpartisan bid for U.S. House in Nebraska's 3rd District
